label: Mean relative error
description: Mean absolute relative error over the leave-one-out thermocouples.

label: MAPE
description: Mean absolute percentage error over non-zero targets.

label: Mean PI error
description: Mean distance of the target outside the 95 % prediction interval.

label: Mean interval score
description: Mean strictly proper interval score; lower is better.

label: PI coverage
description: Fraction of targets inside the 95 % prediction interval; nominal value 0.95.

label: Accuracy (10% tolerance)
description: Fraction of predictions within 10 % relative tolerance.
